name: Hiroshige
contribution: A Japanese ukiyo-e artist, considered the last great master of that tradition.

checks.lead: Utagawa Hiroshige (歌川 広重) or Andō Hiroshige (安藤 広重), born Andō Tokutarō (安藤 徳太郎; 1797 – 12 October 1858), was a Japanese ukiyo-e artist, considered the last great master of that tradition.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
